text:
maria (auditor): Hi team — need to correlate an RBAC change with a set of KMS decrypts during a vuln triage window. Auditor wants proof that the service account change didn't enable widespread data access. Can you help export a minimal evidence bundle?

jamie: @maria (auditor) yes — we can produce a time-bounded bundle. which time window are you asking for?

maria (auditor): 2026-03-14 14:20:00 -> 2026-03-14 15:10:00 UTC. We saw an alert at ~14:45. Need RBAC change events, CloudTrail KMS Decrypt calls, and any related S3/getObject ops.

sara: copying playbook: produce three things — 1) RBAC audit trail (k8s and IAM), 2) KMS usage logs (CloudTrail), 3) data access telemetry (S3 / object read logs + app access). We'll redline minimal set for privacy.

leo: For RBAC: use this kubectl audit lookup and the IAM change log:

kubectl get events --all-namespaces --field-selector involvedObject.kind=RoleBinding,metadata.name=my-service-binding -o json | jq '.'
aws iam get-account-authorization-details --filter User,Role,Group --output json > iam_snapshot.json

Also capture controller manager audit logs around that time: /var/log/kube-apiserver/audit.log (or the cluster audited S3 bucket).

jamie: For KMS decrypts, CloudTrail Insights: run this AWS CLI to extract events for the key id:

aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-14T14:20:00Z --end-time 2026-03-14T15:10:00Z --query 'Events[?contains(CloudTrailEvent, `arn:aws:kms`) ]' > kms_decrypt_events.json

and an AWS Logs Insights query for kms:Decrypt in the trail:

fields @timestamp, eventName, requestParameters, userIdentity.sessionContext
| filter eventName = "Decrypt"
| filter @timestamp >= '2026-03-14T14:20:00Z' and @timestamp <= '2026-03-14T15:10:00Z'
| sort @timestamp asc

sara: For object reads: run S3 access logs and our app request-tracing correlation by request_id. Sample S3 query (if using CloudFront/ALB logs stored in s3-access-logs):

aws s3api select-object-content --bucket redwood-logs --key s3-access/2026/03/14/logs.gz --expression "SELECT s._1, s._7, s._10 FROM S3Object s WHERE s._1 >= '2026-03-14T14:20:00Z' and s._1 <= '2026-03-14T15:10:00Z'" --expression-type SQL --output json > s3_reads.json

leo: Cross-correlation tips: match KMS decrypt events' resourceName (keyId) and the principalIdentity.userName or ARN to the IAM role/service account that was modified in the RBAC delta. Also pull token issuance / kubelet auth logs to ensure no forged tokens.

maria (auditor): What does the evidence bundle look like? Need file list + short mapping doc for each artifact.

jamie: We'll produce an evidence zip with: 
- metadata.json (time window, who ran exports, checksums)
- iam_snapshot.json (IAM state dump)
- k8s_audit_slice.json (kube-apiserver audit records for the window)
- kms_decrypt_events.json (CloudTrail Decrypt events)
- s3_reads.json (S3 access rows that map to decrypts)
- correlation_map.md (human readable mapping: RBAC event -> KMS event -> S3 read)
- redaction_report.txt (fields redacted for PII)

sara: We'll redaction-scan logs for user email/evidence of customer PII, hash object keys when possible. Keep checksums.

jamie: Ops-bot will start exports in a minute. @ops-bot please export and stash to signed S3 presigned url for auditor retrieval. Include a short signed manifest.

ops-bot: Starting export: evidence-export-6234567890-20260314 in progress. Pre-signed link will be valid 7 days.

leo: One more thing — auditors often ask for reproducible queries. We'll attach the exact CLI commands + signed git commit of the extraction script in the bundle.

maria (auditor): Great, please include a short explanation in correlation_map.md showing why a particular decrypt event is or is not linked to the RBAC change (e.g., timing, principal ARN mismatch, request_id). That will speed review.

jamie: Will do. ETA 30–45m. I'll ping here when bundle uploaded. :thumbsup:

maria (auditor): Thanks. If you find any unexpected decrypt volume spike, mark as urgent and loop in oncall.

sara: noted — will flag anomalies.

ops-bot: Export complete: s3://redwood-compliance-exports/evidence-export-6234567890-20260314.zip (pre-signed link: https://presigned.example/ev-6234567890). Manifest checksum: sha256:3a7b9f...

jamie: Bundle uploaded and metadata sent to auditor. Closing loop unless follow-up needed.

maria (auditor): Got it — downloading now. If anything else pops up I'll ask follow-ups here. Thank you all.
